rca_of_issue: Root cause of original bug: react-native-web polyfill of Alert.alert does not render dialogs when more than one button is provided (silent no-op). Confirmation flows in /emergencia (Acionar) and /conveniencia (Enviar pedido) therefore appeared to do nothing on the web preview. Fix: introduced AppDialog (RN Modal + Pressable buttons) used consistently across all confirm flows. Verified on web preview: dialogs now render, confirm buttons are clickable via testID, and downstream actions (create emergency / cancel / order / reboque) execute and show success dialog. Same code path renders natively on iOS/Android via RN Modal — no regression on device.
